in_sanskrit.name: Golu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Hill, Mound
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Golu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Marathi culture, the name Golu refers to a formation of small hills made during the festival of Ganesh Chaturthi. This name is associated with the symbolism of the elephant god Ganesha, who is believed to remove obstacles and bring good fortune.
